dob.title: Date of Birth & Age (DOB & Age) Guide

steps.text: Entering either Age or DOB is sufficient. Providing one will automatically calculate and set the other.

Entering DOB auto-calculates Age and Unit:
Selecting Date of Birth will automatically calculate the exact age and select the appropriate clinical unit:
  • ≥ 1 Year: Age shown in completed years (Unit = "Years").
  • < 1 Year but ≥ 1 Month: Age shown in months (Unit = "Months").
  • < 1 Month but ≥ 7 Days: Age shown in weeks (Unit = "Weeks").
  • < 7 Days (Neonate): Age shown in exact days (Unit = "Days").

Entering Age auto-estimates DOB:
Typing an age and choosing a unit constructs an estimated backend DOB:
  • Years (e.g. 25 Years): Sets estimated DOB to Jan 1st of that birth year.
  • Months (e.g. 6 Months): Sets estimated DOB to the 1st of the calculated birth month.
  • Weeks (e.g. 3 Weeks): Subtracts 21 days (3 × 7) from today's date.
  • Days (e.g. 5 Days): Subtracts the exact number of days from today.
Longitudinal Tracking & Pediatric Care: Dynamic age calculation ensures accurate growth chart plotting (WHO/CDC percentiles) and pediatric vaccine schedule timing on future visits.
Prescription Tracking & History: The Visit ID is tied directly to the clinical encounter. Each prescription has a unique Visit ID allowing precise lookup of the exact consultation notes and Rx state.
Automated Unique Identifier: The system automatically generates and assigns this ID when saving the prescription. No manual entry or modification is required.
Capturing occupational history helps assess socioeconomic status and evaluate occupational health hazards related to presenting complaints.
Common occupations are pre-populated in the dropdown. You can also type custom occupations, which are automatically saved to your practice directory for future prescriptions.
Dropdown suggestions are dynamically ranked by usage frequency. Use the directory management table below to pin frequent occupations, add custom entries, edit, or reset to defaults.

steps.text: Smart Comma (,) Hierarchy: Typing an area name followed by a comma (,) automatically anticipates and suggests parent jurisdictions (e.g., typing Savar, suggests Dhaka).
National Directory & Custom Entries: Autocomplete searches across comprehensive national administrative subdivisions as well as your saved custom addresses.
Frequency-Ranked Predictions: Frequently entered addresses and exact matches are automatically elevated to the top of suggestion lists.
Practice Region Filtering: Select your practice districts below to narrow suggestions to your local catchment area. You can also pin, edit, delete, or add custom addresses.
